clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Faranell prepares Lydon's mixture for a deadly purpose. The Royal Apothecary Society's new plague needs coastal reagents and alchemical draughts before the brew can be used.

Apothecary Lydon sent his Mudsnout Blossom mixture from gnoll-held Nethander Stead to the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell, head of the Royal Apothecary Society, saw its grim potential at once. Pleased by its toxic properties, he added his own colloid of decay. Then he named the catalysts needed to make the mixture a weapon.

Lydon must gather precise reagents in Tarren Mill to activate the mixture's contaminating agents. Faranell calls for a restorative draught of Strong Troll's Blood to feed and steady the chemical reaction. He also needs organic parts from Hillsbrad's southern shore: scales from the serpentine Daggerspine naga and eyes from the coastal Torn Fin murlocs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!

clips.title: Progress
paras: So glad to see you back, friend. I was growing so terribly bored here. Not a single entertaining thing to do besides poison and disease Umpi and reanimate her...over and over and over again.
How went the trip to the Undercity? Were you fortunate enough to slaughter any humans along the way?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy! You have been such a great help, friend. Together we will spread death and disease to this land!
